title: Fix 'not a snap cgroup' error in Snap
summary: Resolve the error '/user.slice/user-1000.slice/session-1.scope is not a snap cgroup' by setting the DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS environment variable.

steps.explain: Set the DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS environment variable for the current session.
To make this permanent, add the export line to ~/.xprofile.
steps.gui: Open ~/.xprofile in a text editor and add: export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bus"

rollback.explain: Remove the line from ~/.xprofile if added.
rollback.gui: Open ~/.xprofile in a text editor and remove the export line.

warnings: This error is related to cgroup v2 support and D-Bus session bus configuration.
